clips.title: The story
paras: At Tarren Mill, High Executor Darthalia directs the Forsaken war in Hillsbrad. Under Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and Varimathras, she targets Southshore and the Syndicate.

High Executor Darthalia commands Forsaken forces from Tarren Mill. She works to contain the human forces in Southshore and hunt the Syndicate brigands across the Hillsbrad Foothills. Every Forsaken offensive in southern Hillsbrad passes through her command.

High Executor Darthalia follows orders from the Undercity's leaders, Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and Varimathras. She directs the war across Hillsbrad, with scouting, strikes against human leaders, and bounties on outlaws who threaten Forsaken control of northern Lordaeron.
